crn: DECK-LEVEL ONLY, WITHIN EACH CELL. Each cell plays its own 400 decks at BOTH seatings and its primary statistic is its OWN internal deck-paired margin D(d) = (diff(a_seat=0) + diff(a_seat=1))/2, adjudicated AGAINST ZERO. ⚠️ THERE IS NO CRN ACROSS CELLS: the seven ranges are DISJOINT, so the pre-registered within-shape low-vs-high contrast (READ_RULE.md §4.5) is an UNMATCHED difference of two independent samples with a root-sum-square SE. That is a real, named power cost and it is stated in the pair rather than discovered at adjudication -- see `disjoint_ranges_rationale`.

no_ident_cell: ⛔ ROUND 2 SPENDS NO SEEDS ON AN IDENTITY CELL. Round 1's IDENT (400 games on band 151000000000) PASSED on every conjunct -- |z| 0.9624 <= 2.0, candidate hash == opponent hash == the champion pin, n_failed 0, leaf diff EMPTY -- and round 2 INHERITS that proof rather than re-buying it for ~15 core-h at round-2 cell size. ⛔ THE INHERITANCE IS CONDITIONAL AND THE CONDITION IS MECHANISED: G-WHEEL-SAME (READ_RULE.md §3) refuses the round unless every manifest's carc_rs_binary_sha equals a9ac686bca1417f9, the wheel round 1's IDENT was measured on. A CHANGED WHEEL RE-OWES AN IDENT CELL, and the launcher asserts the same thing at pre-flight, ON EACH BOX, so a wrong wheel is caught before any game rather than at adjudication. ⭐ THE SHA IS BOX-LOCAL *BY BUILD* -- two boxes COMPILING identical source produce different bytes -- WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY THE TWO-BOX ROUND SHIPS A WHEEL FILE INSTEAD OF BUILDING ONE: the same .whl is scp'd and pip-installed on both boxes, so the sha is identical on every cell regardless of host and this gate passes on both. A laptop-local `maturin build` produces a different sha and the gate REFUSES, correctly.
shape_d_not_run: Shape D (invasion_delta_farm) is NOT RUN in round 2 and spends no seeds. Its round-1 mid read D -0.291 / z -0.490 -- a bounded null below zero -- and DESIGN §3.2(v)'s measured one-ply sibling-delta for T_D is ~0 at 94.6% of the census positions, so a D reading is the least informative of the family about its own mechanism. The owner's funded menu named the B bracket, the A bracket and the C-vs-B-agent cells; D was not on it. No branch may say anything about shape D at any weight other than round 1's mid.
disjoint_ranges_rationale: DELIBERATE, and it costs the PRIMARY read nothing. Each cell's primary statistic is its own internal deck-paired margin against zero, which is fully CRN'd WITHIN the cell (same deck, both seatings) and needs nothing from a sibling. ⚠️ WHAT IT DOES COST IS THE §4.5 CONTRAST: had the two cells of a shape shared one 400-deck set, the low-vs-high difference would have been deck-matched and its SE roughly halved. The funded design named 7 x 400 disjoint decks and this claim honours it; the price is paid explicitly in READ_RULE.md §4.5, which computes SE(Delta) = sqrt(SE_low^2 + SE_high^2) and states that the contrast resolves at 2 sigma only for |Delta| >= ~1.7 pts/deck at round 1's realized dispersion. ⛔ AND NO CROSS-CELL CONTRAST IS A BRANCH INPUT: each cell is adjudicated against ZERO, never against a sibling, and the §4.5 contrast is a SHAPE reading and a round-3 input, never a promotion input.
smoke_range_disjoint: ⭐ ONE DESIGN.md §9 SMOKE PER BOX, each on its OWN disjoint throwaway sub-range, both placed deliberately far above every cell range so no arithmetic slip can reach a real deck: LAPTOP C_MID @ 152999999000..152999999007, LOCAL B_LOW @ 152999999100..152999999107 (8 decks / 16 games each). Both are DISCARDED, never pooled, never claimed, never adjudicated as a result. A single-box round could smoke once; a TWO-box round cannot -- each box has its own wheel install, repo checkout, share mount and W, and the leg exists to prove the plumbing ON THE MACHINE THAT WILL SPEND THE DECKS. ⭐ THE LAPTOP'S IS THE LOAD-BEARING ONE: round 2's most-plumbing config is a C cell (the shape-B env regime, a non-champion OPPONENT leaf, the explicit-zero neutralisation on the candidate side, a THREE-key leaf diff and two-sided hash pins -- all machinery that has never emitted a manifest on ANY box), and the laptop is the box that will run it; C_MID rather than C_LOW/C_HIGH because the interior rung is the one §4.7's noise-signature rule reads. The local leg is a cheap re-confirmation of the launcher and wheel install on a box round 1 already proved. EACH leg ENDS by running the pair's own adjudicator against its own emitted smoke archive and requires failures confined to a pinned allowed set. ⭐ The laptop leg additionally produces the FIRST OBSERVATION of BOTH unmeasured cost inputs -- shape C's per-move cost and the laptop's per-game ratio -- before any deck is spent.
no_topup_reserved: DELIBERATE. READ_RULE.md §5 carries NO top-up branch. A bounded null IS a licensed and expected outcome of a screen, not a failure state to rescue, and an n-extension decided after seeing the numbers is the thing pre-registration exists to prevent.

all_branches_sweep.procedure: measurement/carcasum_arb_challenge_prep/DESIGN.md §4.1, as run by track_d2r4_prep §5 and invasion_screen_prep §5.2: for EVERY ref in refs/heads and refs/remotes, read that ref's OWN governance/BAND_REGISTRY.csv AND every measurement/**/BAND_CLAIM*.json it carries, then take the lowest integer clear of everything found anywhere. A registry check scoped to the checked-out branch is blind to an unmerged sibling freeze branch -- that is how 143e9 and 144e9 were double-claimed.

cross_band_discipline: Per CL-068, band identity is LOAD-BEARING. NEVER pool this pair's numbers with any other band, and NEVER quote a pooled estimate. ⛔ THE SPECIFIC HAZARD THIS ROUND CARRIES: round 1's mids (band 151000000000) are the natural interior points of A's and B's ladders, and the temptation to read a three-point ladder across two bands is exactly the error CL-068 measured -- 1.8-2.2x over-dispersion on cross-band contrasts, in BOTH the elo and the deck-paired-margin statistics, with an identity control exonerating the harness and the 'different decks' explanation arithmetically excluded because the per-deck SEM already prices the deck draw. READ_RULE.md §4.5b therefore admits the r1 mids as a DESCRIPTIVE OVERLAY ONLY: plotted on the ladder, never pooled, never z-combined, never a branch input. The scaling question is answered WITHIN round 2 by the pre-registered low-vs-high contrast. 152000000000 retires from confirmatory use once it has influenced a decision.
release_if_never_launched: If no cell is ever launched, 152000000000 is RELEASED under the BAND_REGISTRY.csv RELEASE-IF-NEVER-LAUNCHED clause -- a band is spent only once REAL RECORDS exist on it. ⚠️ THE CLAUSE DOES NOT SURVIVE FIRST CONTACT: once ANY real record exists, including under a round that voids on G-WHEEL-SAME, the band is SPENT (the 149e9 precedent -- a fifth of one cell was enough).

two_box_execution: ⭐ OWNER-DIRECTED 2026-08-27, verbatim 'get round 2 on both local and laptop'. THE CELL->BOX ASSIGNMENT IS FROZEN IN THE PREREG (screen_lib.CellSpec.box), WHOLE CELLS PER BOX, and G-HOST enforces it against the emitted manifest: LOCAL runs A_LOW A_HIGH B_LOW B_HIGH (W=22, out-root /mnt/c/carc-shared/invasion_screen_r2_20260827); LAPTOP runs C_LOW C_MID C_HIGH (W=22 per h2h_22016_prep's W_LAPTOP, out-root /mnt/carc-shared/invasion_screen_r2_20260827). *** SHAPES ARE ASSIGNED WHOLE, and that is the load-bearing property: every pre-registered statistic -- READ_RULE SS4.5's low-vs-high contrast for all three shapes, SS4.7's noise-signature check across C_LOW/C_MID/C_HIGH, and every cell's own deck-paired margin -- is computed WITHIN ONE BOX. The round therefore never relies on cross-box float identity, which this program HAS been bitten by (the Xeon was re-retired 2026-08-02 because AVX-512 makes the G0 determinism check FAIL by default). *** THE SAME WHEEL FILE is installed on both boxes (scp + pip install, NEVER a laptop-local rebuild), so carc_rs_binary_sha is identical on every cell regardless of host and G-WHEEL-SAME passes on both; a rebuild produces a different sha and the gate REFUSES, correctly. *** THE REPO IS BUNDLE-SYNCED to the laptop (it cannot reach GitHub) and the adjudicator checks that all seven cells report ONE code_rev across both machines. *** Each box writes its own PINNED_SRC_REV / SRC_CLEAN.jsonl / BLIND_PROOF.json / WHEEL_PROBE.json and publishes them to <out-root>/_provenance/<role>/ on the share, so G-REV, G-BLIND and G-WHEEL evaluate every cell against ITS OWN BOX's artifacts. *** ONE SS9 SMOKE PER BOX on disjoint throwaway ranges: laptop C_MID @ 152999999000 (the load-bearing one -- the C cells are simultaneously round 2's new machinery and the laptop's first sight of it), local B_LOW @ 152999999100. *** ADJUDICATION RUNS ON THE LOCAL BOX over the share-collected archives, once BOTH boxes are done. *** THE TWO BOXES RUN CONCURRENTLY, so the round's wall clock is the MAX over them (~4.1 h), not the sum; a single-box local run would be ~6.3 h.
cost: ~165 core-h ACROSS BOTH BOXES (local 74.4 / laptop 90.7), ROUND WALL ~4.1 h concurrent; envelope 155-177 core-h / 3.7-4.7 h. In local-equivalent compute the round is 139.2 core-h.
